AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: With over 3 years of software development experience, I've worked as a Fullstack developer using Angular for frontend and backend engineer with Golang, Python, and Java for building scalable systems. I have worked extensively on REST APIs development, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization with Docker/Kubernetes to enhance system efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.

I have hands-on experience in machine learning, developing predictive models and integrating analytics into applications to support data-driven decision-making. Currently conducting research on applying large language models to GitHub repositories for code insights and summarization.
Some of the technologies that I have trained and worked on include :
